about: The inspection the review demo opens: one project, one run, 31 kept sites in four rules, 2 thrown-out sites and the group reviewer's stage 2 data (candidates, an outlier, a summary). Every site has an id that the overlays and the moved variant refer to. A site's key is worked out from its snippet when the seed runs, so nothing here names a key.

sites.title: Order lookup builds SQL from the order id
sites.body: The query text is assembled with format! from a value the caller supplies.
sites.snippet: format!("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = {}", order_id)

stage1.reason: the id comes straight from the request path

sites.title: Order search builds SQL from the customer name
sites.body: The customer name is placed inside the query text between quotes.
sites.snippet: format!("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer = '{}'", name)
sites.evidence_unverified: the quoted code was not found near the cited line
